title: First-year physics degree — representative electronic-circuit strand

handoff.scope: Inventory and generation/extraction requirements only. No symbol geometry, device models, footprints or application subfolder feature is implemented.
handoff.folder_semantics: folder is a proposed slash-separated logical path, not a claim of support in the current TinyCAD library browser.
handoff.source_document_base: All source_document paths are relative to the repository root, including in standalone library files.
handoff.identity: id is stable within a library; extraction may deduplicate by canonical_symbol_id, but each library is complete and permits independent duplicate assets.
handoff.pin_contract: Logical terminal numbers and signal names are not physical package pinouts. Resolve real package pins from an authoritative device reference before generating package-specific symbols.
handoff.conventions: Prefer IEC/UK teaching symbols. Power pins and polarity should remain explicit. Built-in instruments, probes, independent waveform sources and voltage-controlled sources are excluded from symbol generation. Use existing_tools configuration with the native tool defaults.
handoff.existing_tools: existing_tools and existing_tool_ids refer to supplied non-library tools, not generation requirements. Never recreate these as library symbols.
handoff.inventory_not_bom: One record per reusable symbol type, not per component instance. A bridge can be assembled from repeated diode/resistor symbols. Different resistance/capacitance values are properties, not separate symbols.
handoff.model_warning: Every record is marked not ready to simulate from this manifest. A successful extraction of artwork does not establish a valid model, mapping or instrument implementation.
handoff.optionality: experiment_symbol_ids are a coverage set of proposed implementations and comparisons, not a minimal mandatory BOM; common support symbols and explicitly optional additions are separately identified.

experiments.title: DC network verification
experiments.catalogue_description: Solve a multi-loop network analytically, then compare signed currents and node voltages with the solver. Identify which discrepancies are numerical and which indicate a modelling or sign error.

experiments.title: Source resistance and loading
experiments.catalogue_description: Compare a measured source model with an ideal source while varying the load. Fit an equivalent source resistance from exported terminal readings.

experiments.title: Voltmeter loading
experiments.catalogue_description: Connect a finite-resistance meter to a high-resistance divider. Estimate the expected loading error before running, then compare with a physical meter.

experiments.title: Ammeter burden
experiments.catalogue_description: Repeat a low-resistance current measurement with several declared meter burdens. Quantify how inserting the instrument changes the circuit.

experiments.title: Capacitor combinations and energy
experiments.catalogue_description: Compare charging responses of series/parallel capacitor networks and calculate stored energy. Infer effective C using a stated method rather than a nonexistent virtual capacitance-meter range.

experiments.title: RC charging/discharging
experiments.catalogue_description: Capture both capacitor voltage and resistor current. Fit a decay externally, compare the time constant with component measurements and discuss instrument loading.

experiments.title: RL transient
experiments.catalogue_description: Apply a step to a resistive-inductive circuit, include coil resistance and compare fitted time constant with the model prediction. A lumped inductor does not model the magnetic geometry.

experiments.title: Damped RLC response
experiments.catalogue_description: Change R and compare oscillatory and non-oscillatory responses. Extract a decay rate and oscillation period from an adequately sampled transient.

experiments.title: Complex impedance and phase
experiments.catalogue_description: Sweep RC and RL circuits, measure voltage/current phase and compare with phasor calculations. State the reference direction and phase convention.

experiments.title: Series resonance
experiments.catalogue_description: Sweep an RLC circuit, measure response and bandwidth, then compare the inferred resonance with the transient experiment. Include generator output impedance.

experiments.title: AC power and power factor
experiments.catalogue_description: Average instantaneous load power and compare it with RMS-based apparent power. Calculate power factor and distinguish energy storage from dissipation.

experiments.title: Scope timing and amplitude measurements
experiments.catalogue_description: Compare graticule/cursor estimates with numerical readings as timebase and capture step change. Record the acquisition settings and avoid treating display interpolation as additional samples.

experiments.title: Transistor operating point and gain
experiments.catalogue_description: Bias a prepared BJT circuit, verify its DC state and compare small/large signal behaviour. Compare with a real circuit using an identified device.

experiments.title: Op-amp feedback and limits
experiments.catalogue_description: Test a simple amplifier at several gains and input amplitudes. Compare an idealised prediction with a rail-limited, frequency-dependent model and physical results.

experiments.title: Threshold detector and logic output
experiments.catalogue_description: Apply a slow input and a reference to a comparator, then check the resulting logic levels. The model must represent the required output limits.

experiments.title: Simple logic-network verification
experiments.catalogue_description: Prepare a small network, predict its truth table and exercise every combination. This is a proposed workshop exercise, not a claim that a particular gate exercise is allocated by Warwick.

experiments.title: Sensor calibration and interface loading
experiments.catalogue_description: Enter measured sensor voltage/resistance data and compare interface output for different loading. The physical calibration is obtained independently, not generated by fitting the same simulation.

experiments.title: Component uncertainty and model sensitivity
experiments.catalogue_description: Compare nominal and measured component values, then use bounded sweeps or tolerance studies. Keep manufacturing tolerances, instrument uncertainty and repeated-measurement scatter separate in the analysis.

experiments.title: Electronic measurement-chain documentation
experiments.catalogue_description: Draw sensor, conditioning stage, recorder/controller and references. Annotate supply and test connections. Firmware, physical data acquisition and weather-station operation need other tools.
